answers.core: Interfaces are built-in to other languages, I think this would make sense to be a core part of GDScript and not some external tool. It's akin to classes, functions, variables, etc. so I think it deserved first-class citizenship.
answers.workaround: Technically it can be worked around with the current duck-typing approach. But I think it would make the code cleaner and safer to use explicit Interfaces. It's also easier and faster to write because we would have explicit checks and auto-completion. It's safer because it's more resilient to changes too (e.g. renaming a function wouldn't be flagged if the function is referenced as a string).

title: Allow explicitly defining interfaces in GDScript
